lines.en: What evidence is there of a ghost?
A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.
lines.zh: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近购买的一家酒吧正在出售。

lines.en: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
lines.zh: 汤普森先生打算出售它，因为它闹鬼。

lines.en: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night
lines.zh: 他告诉我，一天晚上他无法入睡

lines.en: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
lines.zh: 因为他听到酒吧里传来奇怪的声音。

lines.en: he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
lines.zh: 他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动了。

lines.en: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed,
lines.zh: 虽然汤普森先生睡前关了灯，

lines.en: they were on in the morning.
He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles
lines.zh: 他还说他发现了五个空威士忌酒瓶，

lines.en: which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
lines.zh: 一定是那个鬼前一天晚上喝光的。

lines.en: When I suggested that some villagers must have come
lines.zh: 当我暗示说一定是一些村民过来

lines.en: in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
lines.zh: 免费喝酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。

lines.en: The villagers have told him that
they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
lines.zh: 即使他白送，他们也不会接受那家酒吧。
